# Wildcard collaborations

We also consider other forms of collaboration with the Translational Sensory & Circadian Neuroscience Unit (MPS/TUM/TUMCREATE), such as an **artist, writer or architect in residence**. Proposals can come from outside academic research and need not fit an advertised project.

## What to propose

A proposal needs a **clear goal and a work plan**. Explain how the work relates to the unit's research, what you would contribute, and what you would like to develop together. Include the planned activities, expected outcome and an indicative timetable.

We consider proposals individually. Any collaboration, including its duration, support and funding, would need to be agreed in advance.

[How to propose a wildcard collaboration](apply.qmd#wildcard-collaborations)
